[list]
[*] Run to cursor with Alt-click

[*] Fixed learderboards bug where failed request results would get cached, and further tweaked throttling

[*] Slowed down playback speeds a bit
[*] New video tutorials for timeline mouse controls (drag/scroll), run to mouse cursor, recycling
[*] Step forward/backward now always at slower speed, regardless of which loop

[*] Updated back button indicator for controller

Happy cooking! 🥑

notes.title: Neon Noodles is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Neon Noodles is OUT NOW!

Lots of changes going into this update!

Most notably, full Windows, Mac, and Linux support, full controller support, Steam deck support, and lots of languages: English, French (France/Canada), German, Spanish (Spain/LATAM), Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Romanian.

Yours,
Head chef Radu 🥑

notes.title: Neon Noodles #14 - The Charred Update
notes.content:
As the name suggests, this is a "burn everything" kind of update, lots of big changes!! Unfortunately, it's also a complete score-wipe, save-reset, progression-clean kind of update.

The big news here is that this makes Neon Noodles complete "content-wise" (though not quite "feature-wise" yet). Read on.

All the levels, mechanics, tools, and the story (missing the end for now) are now in the game. Everything else that remains is tagged under Quality of Life (see Roadmap Steam post for more details).

Here's everything that changed:

[olist]
[*] breaking changes progression/saves/metrics/recipes, so complete scores/saves/progression wipe!
[*] finalized level progression, lots more levels, easily 2x play time compared to before
[*] many more yummy foods from everywhere
[*] story (without ending)
[*] updated Steam page description to be in line with the story
[*] teleport tweaks
[*] station priority/double use error improvements
[*] video tutorials for mouse/controller
[*] portraits
[*] icons refresh, and lot more icons for all the new foods
[*] behind-the-scenes housekeeping (saves/validation)
[*] larger play area mid-late game
[*] proper story-only entries in the companion
[*] an assortment of bug fixes
[*] optional auto-padding in late game
[*] drag to move
[*] finalized metrics
[*] greatly expanded automated test coverage, especially around double use
[/olist]

I hope you enjoy it :) As always, feedback here or in the discord is always welcome.

notes.title: Neon Noodles #11 - The Companion Update
notes.content:
[b]Important: [/b]this update is currently on the [b]beta[/b] branch only!

This is quite a significant update, but some things are not finalized, so it only goes into the [b]beta [/b]branch on Steam for now.

Here are the major changes:

[olist]
[*] Completely new Companion - this covers all the "non-game" part of the game, and it sets the stage for how the story will be delivered too.
[list]
[*] Full mouse, controller and keyboard support for the companion
[*] Dynamic color change based on level
[/list]
[*] New tutorial - this is a video-based approach, vaguely inspired by Frostpunk.
[list]
[*] New levels/introduction to key concepts
[*] A read/unread flag for all of the tutorial entries
[*] Tutorial entries available for later viewing in the Companion
[/list]
[*] Level start transitions - a "scanline" approach to fading the levels in that provides depth, while being very performance focused
[*] Performance improvements - some of this was for the new stuff, but lots of work went into performance. Timeline performance still needs addressing, but that's a bigger piece for a future update.
[*] Some UI/look changes and working towards eventual consistency and what buttons are and how they behave across the entire game.
[*] All music is now back into the game (currently just randomized, not location-specific)
[*] Lots of other small changes, including shadows/lighting improvements, bugfixes, etc.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update #10 - The Ramen Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there, robot chef caretakers! [/h1]

Welcome to the Ramen Update! From now on, Neon Noodles updates will be named after foods in the game :)

This update contains some tasty new content:

[list]
[*] Red Location - this location used Egypt as a reference and will be used for dishes from Africa and Middle East
[*] Green Location - inspired by South America, it will cover foods from the whole area
[*] Soundtrack update - near final version of all the music tracks in the game. Sid once again outdid himself, some amazing tracks in there - here is a sample: https://soundcloud.com/sidbarnhoorn/neon-noodles-i
[*] Histogram visual update - now clearer what scores the buckets contain. More changes are coming here, including starting the histograms from zero, as other games in the genre do.
[*] Timeline fixes - some bug fixes that prevented the entire timeline from being visible in certain cases
[/list]

Here are a couple of screenshots of the new locations:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599771/31c500130ea7a0e08ba3fb2af505af08ac1132c3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35599771/a2b05e27655835f74befa63879eb228c30da5a66.png[/img]

A few more things in the oven for upcoming updates, including a whole new tutorial approach (shamelessly inspired by Frostpunk)

- Radu

PS: Neon Noodles has been busy on the festival front, so I updated the laurels on the Steam page - you'll notice that it was accepted into the prestigious PAX 10, so if you're in Seattle, come say hi!

Happy New Lunar Year! =)

Apologies for the silence the last few weeks. Holiday season is always chaotic and stressful but we're back working on the game! :)

Got feedback? Head over to our [url=http://discord.gg/neon-noodles]Discord[/url] and let us know! =)

- Patrick

notes.title: Community Update #3
notes.content:
[h1]Hey chefs! [/h1]

Thank you for all your feedback so far! Keep it coming. ❤️

We hear you and went over the books again to restructure our planning. A lot of you wish for an improved/reworked UI, which we will deliver within the next few weeks. But that's not all, here are the other improvements that will come within the next couple of weeks:

[list]
[*] Display name for food/ingredients [Done]
[*] Mouse tooltips [Done]
[*] More tutorializing/explaining all the features [Done 90%]
[*] Revamped controls tutorial [Done]
[*] Full mouse support [Done]
[*] variable repeat speed (when holding button down)
[/list][list]
[*] Multiple saves per level [Done]
[*] Main screen for level selection [Done]
[/list][list]
[*] Remapping keys
[*] Updated UI to display different keyboard layouts and remapped keys
[*] Alternate keyboard shortcuts
[/list]

Mouse support is actually already in the game but there is no tutorial for it because it is not 100% completed yet. Feel free to try it out and experiment. When I haven't a controller at hand, I personally always use a mix between keyboard and mouse. Especially being able to click within a program to edit it is very convenient.  

It would help us a lot if you could leave us a review. We're only 1 review away from getting a blue thumbs up! We'd be forever in your debt. 🙏

Got more feedback? Head over to our [url=http://discord.gg/neon-noodles]Discord[/url] and let us know! =)

- Patrick

notes.title: Neon Noodles Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey chefs! [/h1]

It happened! Neon Noodles is now available on Steam! Now, for those of you who are familiar with the zachtronics games, unlike those, this is very much a traditional Early Access title and we have a lot more we want to add to Neon Noodles. 

We will post a road map about what's coming the next few weeks in the following days but first we'd like to hear your feedback. What would you like to see in the game? What needs to be improved? Important features you're missing? According to the feedback we will adjust our road map correspondingly and focus first on what you deem most important.

Got any suggestion on how to improve Neon Noodles? Head over to our [url=http://discord.gg/neon-noodles]Discord[/url] and let us know! =)

- Patrick

notes.title: Community Update #1
notes.content:
[h1]Hey chefs! [/h1]

A lot has happened this week, like the announcement of our Early Access Release Date for example (29th November!). There has also been a lot of activity in our [url=http://discord.gg/neon-noodles]Discord[/url] so we thought it’s best to sum up some of the stuff we talked about in case you missed it. 

[h1]Beta #3[/h1]

The puzzles currently in the beta are limited in complexity to simplify things so I can analyze things properly regarding the metrics that are interesting to use. These levels also don't feature any constraints so the solutions will feel samey. Also, the ingredient dependencies are pretty simple on these recipes (as well as the ingredient multiplicity being always "one" of each).

The checkerboard pattern is one of the common solution patterns when optimizing for cycles. Optimizing for program size will result in different looking solutions, and the third metric (I still haven't finalized which one we'll be using) is meant to push solutions in a different direction.

Cycles is the only metric that will definitely be in the game, so I took it out of this beta to allow you to focus on the more uncertain metrics. 

Staleness increases for every food that's out in the open - so you're trying to minimize the time from picking up stuff to delivering the finished product instead of overall cycles. Like all the other metrics in the current beta, it's an experiment, I just want to see what solutions any of these metrics inspire - with the ultimate goal being solutions that are ideally quite different for the different metrics.

A few things are currently not covered in the tutorial, like conveyor belts or loops. The recipe stations (that make food) all currently behave in the same way, it's all driven by the recipes in the top right. 

Conveyor belts are causing the most bugs at the moment. If you run into a bug, find the log (on Win):
 ...AppData\\LocalLow\\VividHelix 2018\\Neon Noodles\\

...and send it to us on [url=http://discord.gg/neon-noodles]Discord[/url] or submit it via this Google Form: [url=https://forms.gle/rY2BhjSVzfWTJTWs8]click[/url]


[h1]On the list[/h1]
[i](suggestions from the community that are already planned to be implemented)[/i]
[list]
[*] The UI positioning is temporary, currently going through a redesign

[*] "Shifting" programs - you will be able to share and shift the program left or right. I think that will remove the need for waits and minimize the usage of the loop start.

[*] Jump into the code where you were editing last, plus jump to last/first as well as a bot selector if there is more than one bot with code.

[*] There will be conditionals that will affect the programming process, but like a filter inserter from Factorio. Something like a filter push station that only works on certain ingredients/foods.
[/list]
Keep the feedback coming, greatly appreciated!

-Radu

notes.title: Neon Noodles is a Zachlike cookery game about automating meals
notes.content:
We re living in a Zachlike world. It’s a world where games can be about the internal rhythm of things, and where you can create works of art from rulesets. It s why Zachtronic’s game Opus Magnum let people share gifs of what they ve made, explained here by game developer and ex-desk sharer of mine, Tom Francis. And yet this post isn t about a Zach Barth game. This is about Neon Noodles, a game about optimising the work of robot chefs as they prepare meals. It’s the perfect format because food is both a science and art. The open beta is free on Steam right now.

notes.title: Hello World!
notes.content:
We are very proud to finally announce our next game Neon Noodles, which has been secretly in the works for more than a year now! 

We have a deep love for puzzle games, especially ones with a heavy emphasis on automation like the beloved Opus Magnum and other zach-likes.

We enjoyed playing Overcooked quite a lot but always felt it was a bit too chaotic and would rather play for efficiency. Combining this with our love of food and cooking, especially simplifying more common recipes, Neon Noodles was born. 

We’ve come a long way since the beginning and are planning to start beta testing in September. If you’re interested in becoming a beta tester, make sure to follow us to not miss any future announcements:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35599771/9aaa31d0f865141447fd9e8fc6cf581de5ce3a16.png[/img]

If you’re around PAX West in Seattle 30th-31st Augustcome by and say hello! We’ll be showcasing Neon Noodles for the first time in public at the Indie Megabooth and are very much looking forward to hear all your feedback! :)

We are beyond excited with every day that puts us closer to launching Neon Noodles, which is currently planned for Q4 2019. 

See you soon!

Radu, Patrick, Owen, Sid, Farhan
